description: Get product information, features, pricing, licensing FAQs, and role-specific benefits for The Construction Standard — the authorized digital platform for CSI's MasterFormat, UniFormat, and OmniClass construction classification standards. findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.
